title: CompProGraph: Lossless Graph Compression for W3C PROV-JSON Corpora
description: CompProGraph is a lossless, single-pass compression framework for W3C PROV-JSON provenance graph corpora. It combines structural signature hashing (supernode templates + columnar edge encoding) with corpus-wide dictionary encoding to achieve ~72.5% storage reduction while guaranteeing exact canonical-JSON round-trip reconstruction. Developed as part of research into provenance-based cybersecurity for large language models (LLMs), evaluated on the OpenML-CC18 benchmark corpus.
